278789249.description: This listing features a 4-pound assortment of rough, unpolished rocks and minerals originally intended for use with a Dan&Darci Advanced Rock Tumbler. The collection includes various types such as quartz, granite, jasper, and other semi-precious stones, displaying a range of natural colors including brown, white, black, yellow, and blue. The rocks are in their natural state with sharp edges and show no signs of polishing. The lot also includes the original instruction manual and learning guide, but does not come with a rock tumbler machine.
